# AAPI

> OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions gateway. Homepage [aapi.ai](https://aapi.ai). Base URL `https://aapi.ai/v1`. Docs repository [cozcc/aapi](https://github.com/cozcc/aapi). Official list prices only on the [pricing page](https://aapi.ai/pricing).

Send Chat Completions to base URL `https://aapi.ai/v1` (`POST /chat/completions`) with a user API key in `Authorization: Bearer` (environment variable `AAPI_API_KEY`). Do not invent admin APIs. Copy model ids from the pricing page; this file does not quote USD amounts. Claude Code's `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` speaks Anthropic Messages (`/v1/messages`). These docs publish Chat Completions only, and do not set that variable to `https://aapi.ai` or `https://aapi.ai/v1`.

- [Topics index](https://github.com/cozcc/aapi/blob/main/topics/README.md): base URL, pricing pointer, and client-card index
- [Topics index (zh-CN)](https://github.com/cozcc/aapi/blob/main/topics/README.zh-CN.md): Chinese topic index
- [Chat Completions](https://github.com/cozcc/aapi/blob/main/topics/openai-chat-completions.md): base URL, auth header, and request body
- [Chat Completions (zh-CN)](https://github.com/cozcc/aapi/blob/main/topics/openai-chat-completions.zh-CN.md): Chinese Chat Completions page
- [What is AAPI?](https://github.com/cozcc/aapi/blob/main/topics/what-is-aapi.md): hosted product, one key, Chat Completions base URL
- [How to call AAPI with OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions?](https://github.com/cozcc/aapi/blob/main/topics/how-to-call-aapi.md): POST https://aapi.ai/v1/chat/completions
- [What is AAPI Base URL and auth header?](https://github.com/cozcc/aapi/blob/main/topics/base-url-and-auth.md): https://aapi.ai/v1 and Authorization Bearer
- [How to use AAPI in Cursor?](https://github.com/cozcc/aapi/blob/main/topics/use-aapi-in-cursor.md): Override OpenAI Base URL
- [AAPI vs using vendor APIs directly](https://github.com/cozcc/aapi/blob/main/topics/aapi-vs-vendor-apis.md): one key and one Chat Completions URL, versus per-vendor keys and URLs
- [Where are official AAPI prices and model ids?](https://github.com/cozcc/aapi/blob/main/topics/official-prices-and-model-ids.md): https://aapi.ai/pricing
- [Does AAPI support Claude Code / Anthropic Messages?](https://github.com/cozcc/aapi/blob/main/topics/claude-code-and-anthropic-messages.md): published surface is Chat Completions
- [How to get an AAPI API key?](https://github.com/cozcc/aapi/blob/main/topics/get-an-api-key.md): console at https://aapi.ai, env AAPI_API_KEY
- [Client setup overview](https://github.com/cozcc/aapi/blob/main/topics/client-setup.md): shared base URL, key env, and which clients fit
- [Client setup overview (zh-CN)](https://github.com/cozcc/aapi/blob/main/topics/client-setup.zh-CN.md): Chinese client-setup overview
- [Docs repository](https://github.com/cozcc/aapi): public docs and examples; no server source

## Clients

- [Client cards](https://github.com/cozcc/aapi/blob/main/docs/clients/README.md): shared base URL and `AAPI_API_KEY`, then one card per client
- [Client cards (zh-CN)](https://github.com/cozcc/aapi/blob/main/docs/clients/README.zh-CN.md): Chinese client-card index
- [Cursor](https://github.com/cozcc/aapi/blob/main/docs/clients/cursor.md): Override OpenAI Base URL `https://aapi.ai/v1`
- [Cursor (zh-CN)](https://github.com/cozcc/aapi/blob/main/docs/clients/cursor.zh-CN.md): Chinese Cursor card
- [Hermes Agent](https://github.com/cozcc/aapi/blob/main/docs/clients/hermes-agent.md): custom endpoint, provider `custom`, base URL `https://aapi.ai/v1`
- [Hermes Agent (zh-CN)](https://github.com/cozcc/aapi/blob/main/docs/clients/hermes-agent.zh-CN.md): Chinese Hermes Agent card
- [curl](https://github.com/cozcc/aapi/blob/main/docs/clients/curl.md): `POST https://aapi.ai/v1/chat/completions`
- [curl (zh-CN)](https://github.com/cozcc/aapi/blob/main/docs/clients/curl.zh-CN.md): Chinese curl card
- [OpenAI Python](https://github.com/cozcc/aapi/blob/main/docs/clients/openai-python.md): OpenAI SDK `base_url` `https://aapi.ai/v1`
- [OpenAI Python (zh-CN)](https://github.com/cozcc/aapi/blob/main/docs/clients/openai-python.zh-CN.md): Chinese OpenAI Python card
- [Claude Code](https://github.com/cozcc/aapi/blob/main/docs/clients/claude-code.md): Anthropic Messages client; AAPI's published URL is Chat Completions
- [Claude Code (zh-CN)](https://github.com/cozcc/aapi/blob/main/docs/clients/claude-code.zh-CN.md): Chinese Claude Code card
